description:
Planning only: targeted uncovered lines 89, 93, 97, 126, 142, 144 in lib/zaq/agent/tools/search_knowledge_base.ex. Exact tests: test/zaq/agent/tools/search_knowledge_base_test.exs. Single test-surface step; no source edits or new operation. Existing zaq-60a.4 covers multilingual feature implementation but not these error branches; avoid duplicating its scope. Action reuse: not applicable—tests only, no executable operation changed; exercise existing SearchKnowledgeBase Action via run/2 or Jido.Exec.run/3, reuse existing TranslateKnowledgeQuery and ingestion event boundary. E2E: unnecessary for failure-branch unit coverage; existing KB E2E execution remains subject to workflow if subsequent behavior changes.

Tests to add before implementation (no production implementation expected):
1. Discovery returns {:error, :inventory_unavailable}. Purpose-built router clause for %Event{opts: [action: :list_chunk_languages | _], request: %{}} returns error; assert exact {:error, "Knowledge base language discovery failed: :inventory_unavailable"}; any other action raises (prevents hidden search/limit). Hits 89-90.
2. Discovery dispatch raises RuntimeError, e.g. "inventory offline"; assert exact {:error, "Knowledge base search error: inventory offline"}. This must raise synchronously during discovery (task worker exceptions would instead become per-language search failures). Hits rescue 92-93.
3. Discovery returns {:ok, []}; assert {:ok, %{chunks: [], count: 0, errors: [], partial: false}} and no search/limiter/translation invocation (router rejects every other action); no LLM configuration needed. Hits 97-98.
4. Discovery returns {:ok, ["simple"]}, search returns {:ok, [known scored chunk]} with exact access opts and lexical terms, limiter receives that chunk and responds {:error, :context_budget_unavailable}; assert exact {:error, "Knowledge base context limiting failed: :context_budget_unavailable"}. No successful chunk result is returned. Hits 126-127. Keep it distinct from language-search error already covered; prevent accidental limiter rejection due to malformed router matching.
5. Discovery returns {:ok, ["simple", "french"]}, lexical_terms: [] (and focused second example ["   "] if useful); Zoi accepts list of strings, TranslateKnowledgeQuery.run/2 returns {:error, :invalid_lexical_terms}, so translate_languages maps every detected language to %{language: language, stage: :translation, error: :translation_failed}; assert all-languages failure text contains both exact maps / identifiers and no search or limiter invoked. Hits 142-144. Do NOT substitute generator failure: that Action returns {:ok, %{queries: simple, errors: ["french"]}} and does not reach the targeted branch. Do not assert order unless contract promises it. Router can raise if non-discovery action occurs. Capture logging only if needed for warning suppression.

Reuse nearby stub/translation_context patterns, %Zaq.Event{} dispatch pattern, no new Mox, DB records, global env mutation, sleeps, or production test hooks. Keep async: true in existing Zaq.DataCase. If using property coverage for permission guard or input-space invariant, reuse existing explicit nil identity tests and separate bounded ExUnitProperties property for all-empty/whitespace-only lexical lists: each yields global translation failure without widening permissions; avoid duplicating translation Action unit coverage. No new process synchronization is needed; Task.async_stream drains before run/2 returns. Validate with isolated mix test test/zaq/agent/tools/search_knowledge_base_test.exs and mix q at issue completion; full coverage and mix precommit only at lifecycle gates; no commands during planning. Documentation to update: none (tests only). Review exact error contracts, existing success/permission tests, no weakened assertions, no new Action/tool registration. Dependency graph: this issue is independent (single root). Coverage-upper handoff follows reviewed implementation per workflow.

comments.text: Implemented test-only coverage in test/zaq/agent/tools/search_knowledge_base_test.exs for discovery error, synchronous discovery exception, empty inventory short-circuit, limiter failure after successful search, and all-language translation failure for empty lexical terms. No tests/formatting/mix validation run as requested (shared Mix/DB resources); coordinator to authorize isolated validation.
